In this notebook, I will compile scVI differential expression marker data and gene expression of selected markers into a single Excel file

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(writexl)
```

# Read Data

## Annotations

```{r}
obs <- readRDS("out/annotations/scvi/251017__predictCOL_CB_annotations_metadata.rds")
obs
```

```{r}
celltype.levels <- obs %>% pull(celltype) %>% levels
celltype.levels

cellsubtype.levels <- obs %>% pull(cellsubtype) %>% levels
cellsubtype.levels

cellstate.levels <- obs %>% pull(cellstate) %>% levels
cellstate.levels
```


## Markers

```{r}
markers.allcells <- read_csv("out/diffexp/scanpy/AllCells_Type__markers.csv") %>% 
  select(-`gene...1`) %>% 
  rename(gene = `gene...3`)
markers.allcells
```

```{r}
markers.paths <- list.files("out/diffexp/scvi", full.names = T)
markers.paths
```



```{r}
markers.list <- lapply(markers.paths, function(x) read_csv(x, show_col_types = F) %>% 
                         as.data.frame %>% 
                         select(-comparison, -group2) %>% 
                         rename(annotation = group1) %>% 
                         relocate(annotation, gene, is_de_fdr_0.05) %>% 
                         mutate(annotation = case_when(
                           annotation == "PI3+ Epi." ~ "SAA+ Epi.",
                           annotation == "Prlf. Th17.1" ~ "Prlf. Teff",
                           !(annotation %in% c("PI3+ Epi.", "Prlf. Th17.1")) ~ annotation
                         ))
 
)

names(markers.list) <- markers.paths %>% basename %>% str_remove("__markers.csv") %>% str_replace_all("_", " ")

markers.list
```

```{r}
markers.df <- plyr::ldply(markers.list, .id = "comparison")
markers.df
```

```{r}
markers.df.list <- markers.df %>% 
  separate(col = comparison, into = c("celltype", "annotation_level", "relative_group"), sep = " ") %>% 
  mutate(relative_group = ifelse(is.na(relative_group), celltype, relative_group)) %>% 
  mutate(annotation_level = case_when(
    annotation_level == "State" ~ "CellState",
    annotation_level == "Subtype" ~ "CellSubtype",
    !(annotation_level %in% c("State", "Subtype")) ~ annotation_level
  )) %>% 
  relocate(celltype, relative_group, annotation_level, annotation) %>% 
  mutate(celltype = fct_relevel(celltype, celltype.levels)) %>% 
  mutate(relative_group = fct_relevel(relative_group, c(celltype.levels, cellsubtype.levels))) %>% 
  mutate(annotation_level = fct_relevel(annotation_level, c("CellSubtype", "CellState"))) %>%
  mutate(annotation = fct_relevel(annotation, cellstate.levels)) %>% 
  arrange(celltype, annotation_level, relative_group, annotation) %>% 
  group_by(celltype) %>% 
  group_split

names(markers.df.list) <- paste("DE", celltype.levels)

markers.df.list
```

## Shannon Diversity

```{r}
simpson.out <- obs %>% 
  group_by(cellstate) %>% 
  mutate(n = n(), diversity = vegan::diversity(table(biopsy), "simpson")) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  arrange(cellstate) %>% 
  distinct(celltype, cellsubtype, cellstate, n, diversity) %>% 
  rename(
    CellType = celltype,
    CellSubtype = cellsubtype,
    CellState = cellstate,
    Count = n,
    Simpson_Index = diversity
  )

simpson.out
```

```{r, fig.width=45, fig.height=5}
accuracy <- simpson.out %>% 
  mutate(accuracy = ifelse(Count > 1e3, 0.1, 1)) %>%
  pull(accuracy)

ggplot(simpson.out, aes(x = CellState, y = Count)) + 
    geom_col(aes(fill = Simpson_Index, color = Simpson_Index)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label_number(accuracy = accuracy, scale_cut = cut_short_scale())(Count)), 
              nudge_y = 1000, fontface="bold", size = 5) + 
    facet_grid(~CellType+CellSubtype, space = "free", scales = "free") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "identity") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", limits = c(0.5,1), breaks = seq(0.5, 1, 0.1)) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis", limits = c(0.5,1), breaks = seq(0.5, 1, 0.1)) +
    guides(color = "none", fill = guide_colorbar(barheight = 15)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.025, "cm"), 
      panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black", fill = "white"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")  
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Simpson\nIndex")
```


## Gene Expression

```{r}
cellsubtype.assignments <- obs %>% distinct(cellstate, cellsubtype, celltype) %>% arrange(cellstate) %>% pull(cellsubtype, cellstate)
cellsubtype.assignments
```

```{r}
celltype.assignments <- obs %>% distinct(cellstate, cellsubtype, celltype) %>% arrange(cellstate) %>%  pull(celltype, cellstate)
celltype.assignments
```

### Colonic Epithelium

```{r}
seuobj.colepi <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_colepi_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj.colepi
```

```{r}
markers.colepi <- c(    
  'RARRES2', 'LEFTY1',
  'CA1', 'CEACAM7', 'CCL23', 'BEST4', 
  'SPINK4', 'ZG16', 'CCL24', 'REG3A', 'REG4',
  'LGR5', 'PI3', 'SAA1', 'SAA2',
  'PLCG2', 'LRMP', 'NREP', 
  'NEUROG3', 'PYY', 'GCG', 'TPH1',
  'MKI67'
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=11, fig.height=12}
DotPlot(
  seuobj.colepi, 
  features =  markers.colepi, 
  group.by = "cellstate", 
  scale=F) + 
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_size_continuous(limits = c(0,100), range = c(1, 10)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "gray80", high = "red") +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(title = "LogExp", order = 1), size = guide_legend(title = "% Exp", order = 2)) + 
  coord_flip()
```

```{r}
marker.colepi.exp.out <- DotPlot(
  seuobj.colepi, 
  features =  markers.colepi, 
  group.by = "cellstate", 
  scale=T) %>% 
  .$data %>% 
  as_tibble %>% 
  rename(
    CellState = id,
    gene = features.plot,
    AvgExp = avg.exp,
    ScaledExp = avg.exp.scaled,
    PctExp = pct.exp
  ) %>% 
  mutate(CellSubtype = cellsubtype.assignments[as.character(CellState)]) %>% 
  mutate(CellType = celltype.assignments[as.character(CellState)]) %>% 
  relocate(CellType, CellSubtype, CellState, gene, AvgExp, ScaledExp, PctExp) %>% 
  arrange(CellState, gene)

marker.colepi.exp.out
```

# Combine Lists

```{r}
markers.out <- list(
  "Key" = data.frame(), 
  "DotPlot ColEpi" = marker.colepi.exp.out,
  "DotPlot Stroma" = marker.stroma.exp.out,
  "DotPlot Myeloid" = marker.myeloid.exp.out,
  "DotPlot Plasma" = marker.plasma.exp.out,
  "DotPlot BCell" = marker.bcell.exp.out,
  "DotPlot TNKILC" = marker.tnkilc.exp.out,
  "DE Celltypes" = markers.allcells) %>%
  append(markers.df.list)
  

markers.out
```



```{r}
write_xlsx(markers.out, 
           path = "out/tables/Supplemental Table 2 - Gene Markers.xlsx", 
           col_names = TRUE, 
           format_headers = TRUE, 
)
```
